notes.title: Support email and many quality of life improvements
notes.content:
- Added "contact" button on the main menu to give feedback
- Added a timer in one of the later parts to give more direction
- Fixed bugs in the "living room" part of the game
- Added NEW death screen 
- Nerfed parts of the game to make it more accessible
- Made the main character faster to improve playability
